label: “Improve serum stability without losing affinity.”
prompt: Improve serum stability without losing affinity. (peptide design)
workflowNames: Improve serum stability without losing affinity
answerHead:
BioMate

I've planned this as one 2-step analysis: the steps are independent and run in parallel.

Design cyclic/stapled BAK BH3 peptide variants against BCL-XL (chain A of 1BXL.pdb) that improve serum stability while preserving the BAK binding motif (GQVGRQLAIIGDDINR), using the attached peptide_candidates.fasta and peptide_constraints.json; report affinity, serum stability, permeability, aggregation and solubility as predictions with uncertainty — runs gromacs_pmx_fep (runs in parallel)
Evaluate whether the lead single-substitution candidate retains affinity: relative binding free energy (GROMACS pmx FEP) of peptide pair GQVGRQLAIIGDDINR vs AQVGRQLAIIGDDINR bound to BCL-XL receptor 1BXL.pdb — runs gromacs_pmx_fep (runs in parallel) Inputs are set — review the plan, then click Confirm & Run.
